extraction_notes: P-channel numeric values are represented as positive magnitudes for model fitting; source polarity is retained in conditions where applicable.
Transfer, output, and capacitance traces were digitized from the plotted curves on p. 3 without interpolation between plotted observations.
Fig. 5 plots Ciss, Coss, and Crss against -VDS; the figure does not state frequency, while the tabulated capacitances are specified at f = 1 MHz.
The datasheet publishes typical and maximum RDS(ON) values; the schema permits one resistance value per VGS/ID pair, so the typical values are transcribed here.
